note: Inyo NF campground at 7,500 ft beside Rock Creek, a mile up Rock Creek Road from Tom's Place off US-395, in one large loop under pine, aspen and juniper. Mostly small-to-medium RV and tent sites; a few take larger rigs, and seven post a 20-ft limit. Fee showers and supplies at Tom's Place. Bear boxes. --Claude
summary: French Camp (Inyo): $35, +$10 extra vehicle; 86 sites, all reservable on rec.gov, 14 days, Apr 24-Oct 24 2026; flush toilets per FS (stored vault). Max 35 ft; 31 records post 25-35 ft, 7 post 20 ft. Pin ~370 m east of the loop -> 37.5524,-118.6834. Phone -> (760) 935-4824.

FACILITIES conflict: the FS page (updated 2026-09-28) lists 'Flush toilet(s)', but stored vault_toilets true came from note prose, and rec.gov lists no amenities. I set flush_toilets true and left vault_toilets untouched; a curator may want to clear vault_toilets.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept (lead): rec.gov says 'some along the banks of the creek', but names no site. Rock Creek is hidden under dense riparian canopy west of the loop, and the nearest site points (065-070) are ~40-80 m from the canopy's centre. Imagery can't confirm under canopy, so the value stays down. A site map naming the creek sites could earn creekside.
RIG: 7 STANDARD sites post a 20-ft limit; the rest post 25-35 ft or nothing. 'Trailers/RVs over 35ft not recommended' is a length cap, not a class ban.
